notes.title: Tropico for iPhone out now alongside updates for iPad version
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29151223/0c8e22d72d5d8315e1eef0a96ac518e2c82785a3.png[/img]

[i][b]Tropico for iPhone out now alongside updates for iPad version[/b][/i]

Strategy gaming specialists Kalypso Media and developers Feral Interactive have today announced that Tropico, a full-featured premium port for iOS devices based on the classic PC release of Tropico 3, is available now on iPhone from the App Store.

Fully optimised for iPhone, Tropico features intuitive touch controls and an easy-to-navigate user interface that make it smooth and simple for players to lead their proud island nation into a glorious future, one tap at a time. It is also a universal app, meaning that players who have previously purchased the game on iPad will be able to install it on their iPhone at no additional cost, and transfer their save file.

A launch trailer for Tropico on iPhone is available to view below:
https://youtu.be/Mg2zKSkRjTk


The iPad version, released in December 2018, has also been updated today with numerous improvements and new features:
[list][*]El Presidente’s Watchlist: All citizens can now be tracked.
[*]UI Minimizing: Allows a clearer view of the island.
[*]Screenshot mode: UI can be hidden completely.
[*]New illustrations: Critical intel messages, including assassination attempts, feature new illustrations.[/list]


[u][b]Information[/b][/u]
Title: Tropico
Platform(s): iOS (iPhone, iPad)
Developer: Feral Interactive
Genre: City builder / dictator simulator
Release: Out now
Hashtag(s): #Tropico

notes.title: Info about recent small update
notes.notes:
Hi guys!

As some of you may have noticed, there was a small update for Tropico 4 on the 28th of April 2014. Just to eradicate any confusion: This update was solely to address an issue with the korean version of the game and should not really bring any changes to other language versions. Sorry for not addressing this in time. 

If you happen to have any problems or see irregularities after the patch, please contact us at support@kalypsomedia.com 

Many greetings,
Chris

notes.title: Tropico 4 Update Released
notes.notes:
Gameplay Fixes:
- Buffed hotel profits and tourism
- Edicts with monthly/yearly upkeep are no longer free
- Fixed favored trade partner foreign relations bonus
- Private investment offers will not appear for disabled buildings
- Foreign aid given now matches the amount displayed in the notification
- Fixed some cases where citizes walk to their destination instead of taking a car
- Oil cost increase depends on the map's start year
- Weather Station chance of success depends on the workers' skill
- Weather Station properly displays and charges operation costs
- Fire Station area of effect on the Cat-In-Tree work mode increased
- Fixed Mine upgrades
- Radar Dishes on Clear the Airwaves work mode block subversive activities more efficiently
- Fixed housing quality boost of Climate Control upgrade

User Interface Fixes:
- Added option to open the almanac from a choice dialog
- Added setting for controlling scroll speed
- Mouse rollover of people in the Almanac displays their names
- Correctly display resources under embargo in the almanac
- Food-producing buildings now display exports in the info panel
- More information added to some building info panels
- Added controls for navigation to the top and bottom of the highscore list
- Fixed incorrect display of army count in some cases
- Fixed some wrong texts in respect and relation modifiers in the Almanac
- Fixed work mode names text sometimes being cut off
- Fixed a bug preventing users from removing certain building shortcuts
- Various other user interface fixes and improvements

Other Fixes:
- Fixed a rare issue causing the game to freeze shortly after loading a saved game
- Fixed performance problems in some rare circumstances
- Fixed hotkeys that didn't always work for some buildings
- Fixed battleships moving backwards
- Fixed ship sounds
- Game is no longer paused when visiting user-submitted islands
- Challenge Editor: multiple fixes and improvements
- Tropicans now enjoy even longer walks on the beach
- Added Steam Cloud support

notes.title: New Release - Tropico 4
notes.notes:
Tropico 4 - Steam Special Edition is now available for Pre-Purchase on Steam!

The world is changing and Tropico is moving with the times! With new missions, maps, disasters and challenges, El Presidente is back to rule it all!

Tropico 4 makes it easy to tell your friends what you've been up to. With integration into Twitter and Facebook you can post comments and achievements on Twitter direct or upload screenshots of your on Facebook page. You can even compare your interactive Dictator Ranking on the online leaderboards.

The Steam Special Edition of Tropico 4 includes an exclusive island (Isla Nublar) and El Presidente avatar costume (Luchador). For the first time in the Tropico series, the Tropico 4 Steam Special Edition comes with 50 Steam achievements!
